pk.context: 350 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Its 2-hour terminal half-life, and a 10-hour half-life for its CYP2C19-made metabolite, set this muscle relaxant apart.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability has not been determined, and a high-fat meal has no effect. It is converted in the liver by CYP2C19, and eliminated by both renal and non-renal routes.
A crystalline powder with a mild odor and a molecular weight of 260.33.
Approved under an NDA in 250 mg and 350 mg strengths; courses are limited to two or three weeks.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in acute intermittent porphyria and in hypersensitivity to related compounds; drowsiness, dizziness and headache are the most common reactions.
Relief of discomfort from acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions in adults.
Its mechanism has not been clearly identified; in animals it alters interneuronal activity in the spinal cord and brain.
The generic name begins with C and has twelve letters.
